data.name: Second Curse
data.description: You must choose two curses at 1st level. One of these curses (oracle's choice) never changes its abilities as you gain levels; for example, an oracle with clouded vision never gains darkvision 60 feet, blindsense, or blindsight. The other curse comes with its normal benefits.
